question: Which horned, horn-fond, and brown divine aspects are honored by salutation in this litany?
premises: The horned one is addressed with salutation.
The one fond of horns is addressed with salutation.
The brown one is addressed with salutation.
inference: These epithets designate specific aspects of the deity receiving homage.
plain_english: Salutation to the horned one, salutation to the one fond of horns, salutation to the brown one.
